# Markdown preview

Preview Markdown in the terminal (headings, lists, tables, code).

Category: Text · ID: `markdown` · Search terms: md, readme, preview, glamour, commonmark, gfm

## Command line

```bash
devtooltui markdown [file|-] [flags]
```

## Inputs

1. Markdown
